knowledge.name: Unit 1 What is your family like? / Practice
Family members 家庭成员
knowledge.parent: Unit 1 What is your family like? / Practice
knowledge.explanation: father / mother / brother / sister / grandpa / grandma，注意 brother、sister 不分长幼，都可用。

knowledge.name: Unit 1 What is your family like? / Communicate
This is my 介绍家人
knowledge.parent: Unit 1 What is your family like? / Communicate
knowledge.explanation: 指着家人介绍用 This is my father / mother；This is 用于近处单数的人或物。

knowledge.name: Who is he 询问身份
knowledge.parent: Unit 1 What is your family like? / Communicate
knowledge.explanation: 问男性用 Who is he? 问女性用 Who is she? 回答 He is my brother. / She is my sister.
prerequisites: This is my 介绍家人

knowledge.name: Unit 1 What is your family like? / Letters
Alphabet order 字母表顺序
knowledge.parent: Unit 1 What is your family like? / Letters
knowledge.explanation: 字母按 Aa→Zz 的固定顺序排列：Cc 的大写形式是 C，Ee 前面是 Dd，Gg 排在 Ff 后面。认读时先记住顺序，再练大小写配对。

chapters.name: Unit 1 What is your family like?

questions.analysis: mother 是妈妈；father 是爸爸，brother 是兄弟，sister 是姐妹，三个都不是「妈妈」。
grandpa 是爷爷/外公；grandma 是奶奶/外婆，father 是爸爸，uncle 是叔叔舅舅。

questions.stem: This is my （  ）. She is my mother.
questions.analysis: 后句 She is my mother 已提示是妈妈，所以横线填 mother；填 mother's 会变成所有格，语法不通。
questions.knowledge_point: This is my 介绍家人

questions.stem: brother 既可以指哥哥，也可以指弟弟。
questions.analysis: 英语里 brother 不区分长幼，要明确说「哥哥」需用 elder brother，「弟弟」用 younger brother。

questions.stem: 向别人介绍身边的爸爸，应该说（  ）
questions.analysis: 介绍近处的人用 This is my + 名词；B 少了 my 且语序不通，C 语序错，D 缺动词。
questions.knowledge_point: This is my 介绍家人

questions.stem: — Who is （  ）? — She is my sister.
questions.analysis: 回答用 She，问句就要用 Who is she?；用 he 与回答的 She 不一致。
questions.knowledge_point: Who is he 询问身份

questions.stem: 下列单词中，属于家庭成员的有（  ）
questions.analysis: A sister 姐妹 ✓；B grandma 奶奶 ✓；C teacher 老师，是职业身份不是家庭成员 ✗；D brother 兄弟 ✓。故 A、B、D 成立，C 不成立。

questions.stem: 回答 Who is she? 可以说 She is my mother.
questions.analysis: 问女性身份用 she，回答也用 she，句型 She is my + 名词，说法正确。
questions.knowledge_point: Who is he 询问身份

questions.stem: 字母 Cc 的大写形式是（  ）
questions.analysis: 小写 c 的大写是 C；B 仍是小写，G、D 是别的字母。
四个字母依次是 A、B、C、D，所以空里填 Dd；写 D 也要保持大小写都写，写 Bb 或 Ee 都顺序错。

questions.stem: 字母 Gg 排在 Ff 前面。
questions.analysis: 顺序是 …Ee、Ff、Gg，G 在 F 后面而不是前面，说法错误。

questions.stem: 关于 This is my father. 这句话，说法正确的有（  ）
options: 这句话是在问对方爸爸是谁
questions.analysis: A This 指近处单数的人或物 ✓；B my 是物主代词「我的」✓；C father 意为爸爸 ✓；D 这是陈述句，不是疑问句，也不是在问对方爸爸是谁 ✗。故 A、B、C 成立，D 不成立。
questions.knowledge_point: This is my 介绍家人

questions.stem: — Who is he? — （  ） is my brother.
questions.analysis: 问句用 he，回答也用 he；She 性别不符，It 用于物，This 指近处事物。
questions.knowledge_point: Who is he 询问身份

questions.stem: This is my （  ）. He is my father's father.
questions.analysis: 爸爸的爸爸就是爷爷，用 grandpa；写 grandfather 也对，写 grandma 则性别不符。

questions.stem: 介绍家人时，This is my mother. 比 This is mother. 更符合英语习惯。
questions.analysis: 英语里表示亲属关系一般要带物主代词 my，单说 This is mother 不合习惯。
questions.knowledge_point: This is my 介绍家人

questions.stem: 用英语写三句话介绍你的家庭：一句说 This is my…，一句说 He/She is my…，一句写出这个人的一个特点（如 tall、kind）。

answer.value: This is my father. He is my father. He is tall and kind.

questions.analysis: 参考答案：This is my father. He is my father. He is tall and kind.（也可换成 mother / brother / sister）评分要点：①用上 This is my…（1 分）；②用上 He/She is my…（1 分）；③写出一个特点（形容词）（1 分）；④大小写与标点正确（1 分）。三句都写同一句型不得分。
questions.knowledge_point: This is my 介绍家人

questions.stem: 把下面的对话补全并译成中文：A: Who is （  ）? B: She is my sister. A: （  ） is she? B: She is six.

answer.value: she；How old。译文：A：她是谁？B：她是我妹妹。A：她多大了？B：她六岁。

questions.analysis: 参考答案：第一空 she；第二空 How old（问年龄）。译文见答案。评分要点：①两空正确（2 分）；②三句译文准确（2 分）；③大小写与标点（1 分）。第二空填 Who 则答语 She is six 无法对应。
questions.knowledge_point: Who is he 询问身份

questions.stem: This is my grandmother. We can also call her （  ）.
questions.analysis: grandmother 与 grandma 同义，grandma 更口语化；填 grandpa 则变成爷爷，性别不符。
